version.changelog: Pin the Maton CLI install to 0.3.4, the current release.

llm.summary: This skill coherently documents a Maton-based Vercel integration with expected account access and clear approval guidance for high-impact actions.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Bash, and a Maton account are proportionate for an authenticated API integration; the raw HTTP fallback is limited to environments without the CLI and includes credential-handling cautions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned Maton CLI version via npm or Homebrew, with optional pinned SDK examples; no executable scripts are shipped in the skill package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list operations, require explicit approval for connection creation and writes, and do not contain hidden prompt overrides or purpose-mismatched agent-control behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth/API credentials, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can persist beyond one session, but the artifact discloses this and repeatedly requires user approval, least-privilege scoping, and cleanup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill can manage Vercel projects, deployments, domains, teams, and environment variables, including production-impacting writes, but those capabilities match the stated Vercel management purpose and are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use Maton to access your Vercel account. Review OAuth scopes, prefer read-only actions first, confirm any write, deployment, domain, environment-variable, function, trigger, or destination change, and revoke unused connections when finished.
